package main

	"encoding/json"

	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/ast"

)

// Only this Go test build renames the production implementation and installs
// this wrapper. No public compiler request can select or replace an algorithm.
var nativeInvariantMint = productionStableErrorIdentity

func TestNativeInvariantExplicitPlanBindings(t *testing.T) {
	contract := map[string]any{"id": "test/Action", "version": 3,
		"inputSchema":   durableStructuralSchema("input", map[string]any{"kind": "number"}),
		"successSchema": durableStructuralSchema("success", map[string]any{"kind": "number"}),
		"errorSchema":   durableStructuralSchema("error", map[string]any{"kind": "never"})}
	contract["contractDigest"] = durableDigest(contract)
	binding := planSourceActionBinding{ModuleSpecifier: "./actions", ExportName: "Work", DescriptorJSON: durableCanonicalJSON(contract)}
	source := `import {durable} from "vibelang:flows";import {Work} from "./actions";export const Build=durable((n:number)=>{return Work.run(n)})`
	got, err := compilePlanSource(context.Background(), planSourceRequest{Source: source, FileName: "source.vibe", FlowVersion: 1, Mode: "plan", Actions: []planSourceActionBinding{binding}})
	if err != nil || got.Status != "plan" {
		p, _ := buildProject(request{Lowering: "internal", RootNames: []string{"input.vibe"}, Files: []sourceFile{{Path: "input.vibe", Kind: "vibelang", Text: source}}})
		p.checkedFiles[durableVirtualName] = planSourcePreludeText
		staged, installErr := installPlanActionBindings(p, []planSourceActionBinding{binding})
		options, _, _ := compilerOptions(map[string]any{"target": "esnext"})
		configureInternalModules(options)
		program := newCheckProgram(options, p)
		var details []string
		for _, file := range program.SourceFiles() {
			if strings.HasPrefix(file.FileName(), "/src/") {
				details = append(details, file.FileName())
				for _, imported := range file.Imports() {
					details = append(details, imported.Text())
				}
			}
		}
		t.Fatalf("binding failed: %+v err=%v staged=%+v install=%v graph=%v diagnostics=%v", got, err, staged, installErr, details, program.GetSemanticDiagnostics(context.Background(), nil))
	}
}

func stableErrorIdentity(sourceName, name string) string {
	return nativeInvariantMint(sourceName, name)
}

func historicalInvariantMint(sourceName, name string) string {
	var normalized strings.Builder
	for _, unit := range utf16.Encode([]rune(sourceName)) {
		if isStableIdentityAlphanumeric(unit) || strings.ContainsRune("._/@:+-", rune(unit)) {
			normalized.WriteRune(rune(unit))
		} else {
			normalized.WriteByte('_')
		}
	}
	path := normalized.String()
	if path != "" && !isStableIdentityAlphanumeric(uint16(path[0])) {
		path = "source_" + path
	}
	units := utf16.Encode([]rune("vibelang:" + path + ":" + name))
	if len(units) > 256 {
		units = units[:256]
	}
	if len(units) > 0 && units[len(units)-1] >= 0xd800 && units[len(units)-1] <= 0xdbff {
		units = units[:len(units)-1]
	}
	return string(utf16.Decode(units))
}

func invariantCompile(t *testing.T, names ...string) result {
	t.Helper()
	input := request{Lowering: "internal", Options: map[string]any{"target": "esnext"}, RootNames: []string{}, Files: []sourceFile{}}
	for _, name := range names {
		input.RootNames = append(input.RootNames, name)
		input.Files = append(input.Files, sourceFile{Path: name, Kind: "vibelang", Text: "\nexport class Boom extends Error {}\n"})
	}
	got, err := compile(context.Background(), input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return got
}

func invariantCollisions(result result) []diagnostic {
	found := []diagnostic{}
	for _, issue := range result.Diagnostics {
		if issue.Code == "VIBE1151" {
			found = append(found, issue)
		}
	}
	return found
}

func TestNativeInvariantNominalCollision(t *testing.T) {
	nativeInvariantMint = historicalInvariantMint
	t.Cleanup(func() { nativeInvariantMint = productionStableErrorIdentity })
	got := invariantCompile(t, "a b.vibe", "a_b.vibe")
	failures := invariantCollisions(got)
	if len(failures) != 1 || !got.EmitSkipped || len(got.Artifacts) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("collision was not an emission refusal: %+v", got)
	}
	issue := failures[0]
	for _, text := range []string{`Error class "Boom" in "a_b.vibe"`, "cannot receive a stable nominal identity", "vibelang:a_b.vibe:Boom", `"a b.vibe:Boom" already holds`} {
		if !strings.Contains(issue.Message, text) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %q in %+v", text, issue)
		}
	}
	if issue.Category != "error" || issue.File != "a_b.vibe" || issue.Span == nil || issue.Span.Start != 1 || issue.Span.Length != len("export class Boom extends Error {}") {
		t.Fatalf("collision lost the authored declaration position: %+v, span %+v", issue, issue.Span)
	}
}

func TestNativeInvariantNominalCompileScope(t *testing.T) {
	nativeInvariantMint = historicalInvariantMint
	t.Cleanup(func() { nativeInvariantMint = productionStableErrorIdentity })
	for _, name := range []string{"a b.vibe", "a_b.vibe"} {
		got := invariantCompile(t, name)
		if len(got.Diagnostics) != 0 || got.EmitSkipped {
			t.Fatalf("separate compile retained another compilation's claims: %+v", got)
		}
	}
	if len(invariantCollisions(invariantCompile(t, "a b.vibe", "a_b.vibe"))) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("claim map is no longer compile-wide")
	}
}

func TestNativeInvariantNominalIdempotence(t *testing.T) {
	const source = "\nexport class Boom extends Error {}\n"
	file := parser.ParseSourceFile(ast.SourceFileParseOptions{FileName: "/src/a b.vibe", Path: tspath.Path("/src/a b.vibe")}, source, core.ScriptKindTS)
	class := file.Statements.Nodes[0]
	claims := map[string]string{}
	for count := 0; count < 2; count++ {
		low := &lowerer{file: file, identities: claims}
		low.claimNominalErrorIdentity(class, "a b.vibe", historicalInvariantMint("a b.vibe", "Boom"))
		if len(low.reports) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("repeat claim was a collision: %+v", low.reports)
		}
	}
	if len(claims) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("repeat claim changed inventory: %+v", claims)
	}
	conflicting := &lowerer{file: file, identities: claims}
	conflicting.claimNominalErrorIdentity(class, "a_b.vibe", historicalInvariantMint("a_b.vibe", "Boom"))
	if len(conflicting.reports) != 1 || conflicting.reports[0].code != "VIBE1151" {
		t.Fatal("idempotence erased collision detection")
	}
}

func TestNativeInvariantNominalProductionControl(t *testing.T) {
	nativeInvariantMint = productionStableErrorIdentity
	got := invariantCompile(t, "a b.vibe", "a_b.vibe")
	if len(got.Diagnostics) != 0 || got.EmitSkipped {
		t.Fatalf("production algorithm refuses distinct names: %+v", got)
	}
	if stableErrorIdentity("a b.vibe", "Boom") == stableErrorIdentity("a_b.vibe", "Boom") {
		t.Fatal("production identities collided")
	}
}

func TestNativeInvariantModuleQualifiers(t *testing.T) {
	bytes, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("VIBELANG_NATIVE_INVARIANT_VECTORS"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var corpus struct {
		Vectors []struct {
			Module    string
			Qualifier string
		}
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(bytes, &corpus); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(corpus.Vectors) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("empty qualifier vectors")
	}
	seen := map[string]string{}
	for _, vector := range corpus.Vectors {
		logical := strings.TrimSuffix(vector.Module, ".vibe")
		actual := moduleRowQualifier(logical)
		if actual != vector.Qualifier {
			t.Fatalf("%q: got %q want %q", vector.Module, actual, vector.Qualifier)
		}
		if prior, ok := seen[actual]; ok && prior != vector.Module {
			t.Fatalf("%q and %q share %q", prior, vector.Module, actual)
		}
		seen[actual] = vector.Module
		units := []uint16{}
		for offset := 0; offset < len(actual); {
			if actual[offset] != '+' {
				units = append(units, uint16(actual[offset]))
				offset++
				continue
			}
			if offset+5 > len(actual) {
				t.Fatalf("incomplete qualifier escape: %q", actual)
			}
			var value uint16
			for _, digit := range actual[offset+1 : offset+5] {
				value <<= 4
				if digit >= '0' && digit <= '9' {
					value += uint16(digit - '0')
				} else if digit >= 'A' && digit <= 'F' {
					value += uint16(digit - 'A' + 10)
				} else {
					t.Fatalf("invalid escape: %q", actual)
				}
			}
			units = append(units, value)
			offset += 5
		}
		if string(utf16.Decode(units)) != logical {
			t.Fatalf("qualifier lost information: %q -> %q", logical, actual)
		}
	}
}

// Private AST/checker invariants belong beside the native implementation, not
// in a second compiler API exported to a JavaScript test runner. These helpers
// use the real production analysis with the checker's actual callback lifetime.
func invariantAnalysis(t *testing.T, source string, consume func(*internalAuthoredAnalysis)) {
	t.Helper()
	project, err := buildProject(request{Lowering: "internal", RootNames: []string{"effects.vibe"},
		Files: []sourceFile{{Path: "effects.vibe", Kind: "vibelang", Text: source}}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	options, issues, err := compilerOptions(map[string]any{"target": "esnext"})
	if err != nil || len(issues) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("options: %v, %v", err, issues)
	}
	called := false
	got, err := withInternalAuthoredAnalysis(context.Background(), options, project, false, nil, func(state *internalAuthoredAnalysis) (result, error) {
		called = true
		consume(state)
		return result{Diagnostics: state.collector.converted, Artifacts: []artifact{}}, nil
	})
	if err != nil || !called || len(got.Diagnostics) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("analysis not measured: called=%v err=%v diagnostics=%+v", called, err, got.Diagnostics)
	}
}

const invariantServiceSource = `
import { Context } from "vibelang/context"
abstract class Reader extends Context { abstract read(key: string): string }
class Missing extends Error {}
function lookup(key: string): Result<string, Missing> { return key }
export function run(key: string): Result<string, Missing> {
  const found = lookup(key)!
  return Reader.context().read(found)
}
`

func invariantEffectNodes(state *internalAuthoredAnalysis) []*ast.Node {
	nodes := []*ast.Node{}
	var walk func(*ast.Node) bool
	walk = func(node *ast.Node) bool {
		_, context := state.analysis.contextRequirement(node)
		if context || node.Kind == ast.KindNonNullExpression {
			nodes = append(nodes, node)
		}
		return node.ForEachChild(walk)
	}
	walk(state.files[0].AsNode())
	return nodes
}

func invariantLowerer(state *internalAuthoredAnalysis) *lowerer {
	a := state.analysis
	low := newLowerer(a.checker, a.prelude, a, a.comptime, map[string]string{})
	low.file = state.files[0]
	return low
}

func TestNativeInvariantContextClassification(t *testing.T) {
	invariantAnalysis(t, invariantServiceSource, func(state *internalAuthoredAnalysis) {
		if len(state.analysis.reports[state.files[0]]) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("valid service diagnostics: %+v", state.analysis.reports)
		}
		nodes := invariantEffectNodes(state)
		if len(nodes) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("want get and abort, found %d", len(nodes))
		}
		var call *ast.Node
		for _, node := range nodes {
			if ast.IsCallExpression(node) {
				call = node
			}
		}
		receiver, recognized := state.analysis.contextRequirement(call)
		if !recognized || receiver.kind != contextReceiverCapability || receiver.symbol == nil || receiver.symbol.Name != "Reader" {
			t.Fatalf("lost nominal Reader receiver: %+v, recognized=%v", receiver, recognized)
		}
		// Classifying the same checked node must be idempotent by symbol identity.
		again, ok := state.analysis.contextRequirement(call)
		if !ok || again != receiver {
			t.Fatal("context classification changed on the same node")
		}
	})
	invariantAnalysis(t, `import { Context } from "vibelang/context";
abstract class Left extends Context { abstract read(): string }
abstract class Right extends Context { abstract read(): string }
export function run(flag: boolean): string { const which = flag ? Left : Right; return which.context().read() }`, func(state *internalAuthoredAnalysis) {
		nodes := invariantEffectNodes(state)
		if len(nodes) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("ambiguous read disappeared: %d", len(nodes))
		}
		receiver, recognized := state.analysis.contextRequirement(nodes[0])
		if !recognized || receiver.kind != contextReceiverAmbiguous || receiver.symbol != nil {
			t.Fatalf("ambiguous receiver was certified: %+v", receiver)
		}
		issues := state.analysis.reports[state.files[0]]
		if len(issues) != 1 || issues[0].code != "VIBE2106" {
			t.Fatalf("lost refusal: %+v", issues)
		}
		if id := invariantLowerer(state).effectSite(nodes[0], "get"); !strings.HasPrefix(id, "src-") || len(id) != 28 {
			t.Fatalf("ambiguous node crashed/lost site identity: %q", id)
		}
	})
	invariantAnalysis(t, `class Context { static context(): number { return 1 } }
export function run(): number { return Context.context() }`, func(state *internalAuthoredAnalysis) {
		if len(invariantEffectNodes(state)) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("user-spelled Context became compiler authority")
		}
	})
}

func TestNativeInvariantEffectSiteIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	var previous []string
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 2; attempt++ {
		invariantAnalysis(t, invariantServiceSource, func(state *internalAuthoredAnalysis) {
			nodes, low := invariantEffectNodes(state), invariantLowerer(state)
			if len(nodes) != 2 {
				t.Fatalf("want two actual authored sites, found %d", len(nodes))
			}
			ids := []string{}
			for _, node := range nodes {
				kind := "abort"
				if ast.IsCallExpression(node) {
					kind = "get"
				}
				id := low.effectSite(node, kind)
				if !strings.HasPrefix(id, "src-") || len(id) != 28 {
					t.Fatalf("invalid site: %q", id)
				}
				if low.effectSite(node, kind) != id {
					t.Fatal("same-node site was not idempotent")
				}
				ids = append(ids, id)
			}
			if ids[0] == ids[1] {
				t.Fatal("distinct authored sites share an identity")
			}
			if attempt > 0 && strings.Join(ids, ",") != strings.Join(previous, ",") {
				t.Fatal("recompilation changed identities")
			}
			previous = ids
			get := invariantLowerer(state).effectSite(nodes[0], "get")
			abort := invariantLowerer(state).effectSite(nodes[0], "abort")
			if get == abort {
				t.Fatal("request kind is missing from identity")
			}
			// Test the production collision guard without introducing an alternate
			// public hashing algorithm: install a conflicting recorded owner.
			conflict := invariantLowerer(state)
			conflict.effectSiteOwners[get] = nodes[1]
			conflict.effectSite(nodes[0], "get")
			if len(conflict.reports) != 1 || conflict.reports[0].code != "VIBE4199" {
				t.Fatal("site collision was not refused")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNativeInvariantDurableCapabilityClassifier(t *testing.T) {
	invariantAnalysis(t, `import { Context } from "vibelang/context";
abstract class Reader extends Context { abstract read(): string }
abstract class Settings extends Context { abstract readonly retries: number }
export function service(): Reader { return Reader.context() }
export function data(): Settings { return Settings.context() }
export function record(): { readonly retries: number } { return { retries: 3 } }`, func(state *internalAuthoredAnalysis) {
		contracts := &durableFunctionLowerer{owner: invariantLowerer(state)}
		measured := 0
		for _, node := range state.files[0].Statements.Nodes {
			if !ast.IsFunctionDeclaration(node) {
				continue
			}
			measured++
			descriptor, err := contracts.durableTypeDescriptor(state.analysis.checker.GetTypeFromTypeNode(node.Type()), node, map[checker.TypeId]bool{}, false)
			if node.Name().Text() == "record" {
				if err != nil || descriptor.(map[string]any)["kind"] != "object" {
					t.Fatalf("plain record codec refused: %v, %+v", err, descriptor)
				}
			} else if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "class instances") {
				t.Fatalf("capability %s acquired a persistence codec: %v, %+v", node.Name().Text(), err, descriptor)
			}
		}
		if measured != 3 {
			t.Fatalf("codec classifier inventory: %d", measured)
		}
	})
}

func TestNativeInvariantCompilerModuleIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	var source strings.Builder
	for index, specifier := range compilerModuleSpecifiers {
		source.WriteString("import * as M" + string(rune('A'+index)) + " from " + strconv.Quote(specifier) + ";\n")
	}
	source.WriteString("export function run(): number { return 1 }\n")
	invariantAnalysis(t, source.String(), func(state *internalAuthoredAnalysis) {
		measured := 0
		for _, node := range state.files[0].Statements.Nodes {
			if !ast.IsImportDeclaration(node) {
				continue
			}
			measured++
			if !state.analysis.prelude.isCompilerModuleSpecifier(node.AsImportDeclaration().ModuleSpecifier) {
				t.Fatalf("compiler module lost its resolved identity: %s", node.AsImportDeclaration().ModuleSpecifier.Text())
			}
		}
		if measured == 0 || measured != len(compilerModuleSpecifiers) {
			t.Fatalf("module inventory: %d", measured)
		}
		alias := state.analysis.prelude.resultAlias
		if alias == nil || ast.GetSourceFileOfNode(alias).FileName() != preludeVirtualName || preludeVirtualName == preludeLogicalPath {
			t.Fatal("prelude Result was not identified by the compiler-owned absolute virtual path")
		}
	})
}

func TestNativeInvariantDurableWireCompatibility(t *testing.T) {
	kind := func(name string) any { return map[string]any{"kind": name} }
	literal := func(value any) any { return map[string]any{"kind": "literal", "value": value} }
	array := func(element any) any { return map[string]any{"kind": "array", "element": element} }
	tuple := func(items ...any) any { return map[string]any{"kind": "tuple", "items": items} }
	union := func(variants ...any) any { return durableCanonicalUnion(variants) }
	field := func(name string, optional bool, value any) any {
		return map[string]any{"name": name, "optional": optional, "value": value}
	}
	object := func(fields ...any) any { return map[string]any{"kind": "object", "fields": fields} }
	nominal := func(identity string, payload any) any {
		return map[string]any{"kind": "error", "identity": identity, "name": "Error", "payload": payload}
	}
	number, str, boolean := kind("number"), kind("string"), kind("boolean")
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name             string
		actual, expected any
		fits             bool
	}{
		{"equal", number, number, true},
		{"mismatch", str, number, false},
		{"unknown", durableUnknownDescriptor{}, number, false},
		{"unreachable", kind("never"), number, true},
		{"literal number", literal(float64(2)), number, true},
		{"literal string", literal("two"), str, true},
		{"literal boolean", literal(false), boolean, true},
		{"literal mismatch", literal("two"), number, false},
		{"literal narrowing", number, literal(float64(2)), false},
		{"null", literal(nil), kind("null"), true},
		{"null literal", kind("null"), literal(nil), true},
		{"union source", union(number, str), union(number, str, boolean), true},
		{"union partial source", union(number, str), number, false},
		{"union target", number, union(number, str), true},
		{"boolean union", boolean, union(literal(false), literal(true)), true},
		{"arrays", array(literal("x")), array(str), true},
		{"array mismatch", array(str), array(number), false},
		{"tuple array", tuple(literal(2), number), array(number), true},
		{"empty array", tuple(), array(number), true},
		{"tuple mismatch", tuple(str), array(number), false},
		{"fixed tuple", tuple(literal(2), literal("x")), tuple(number, str), true},
		{"tuple length", tuple(number), tuple(number, str), false},
		{"array is not fixed tuple", array(number), tuple(number), false},
		{"required", object(field("n", false, literal(2))), object(field("n", false, number)), true},
		{"missing", object(), object(field("n", false, number)), false},
		{"optional absent", object(), object(field("n", true, number)), true},
		{"required to optional", object(field("n", false, number)), object(field("n", true, number)), true},
		{"optional to required", object(field("n", true, number)), object(field("n", false, number)), false},
		{"wire rejects width", object(field("n", false, number), field("s", false, str)), object(field("n", false, number)), false},
		{"nominal payload", nominal("a@Error@1", object(field("n", false, literal(2)))), nominal("a@Error@1", object(field("n", false, number))), true},
		{"nominal identity", nominal("a@Error@1", object()), nominal("b@Error@1", object()), false},
	} {
		if got := durableDescriptorFits(tc.actual, tc.expected); got != tc.fits {
			t.Errorf("%s: compatibility %v, want %v", tc.name, got, tc.fits)
		}
	}
	actual, expected := literal(2), number
	for range 66 {
		actual, expected = array(actual), array(expected)
	}
	if durableDescriptorFits(actual, expected) {
		t.Fatal("compatibility walk exceeded its depth limit")
	}
}
